title: End-to-end test: an unlisted Remote answer to a rebind's recovery checkpoint keeps the cached report
outcome: A scripted mediated-turn test (for example a LostThenRecoveryUnresolved script, using remote_error_reply("storage_error") on the rebind's recovery checkpoint) asserts that active_turn_report still holds the full report after the failed recovery, which covers the keep-and-log branch at the rebind-recovery call site end to end.
acceptance: End-to-end test: an unlisted Remote answer to a rebind's recovery checkpoint keeps the cached report is done
